content: MobileRead Calibre plugin thread convention (observed across Quality Check, Action Chains, FanFicFare threads): first post = short description, feature bullet list, install note pointing to the 'Introduction to plugins' thread, calibre-version requirement line, screenshots as numbered forum attachments, a changelog section (version/date/Fix-Update-Misc entries) that gets edited in place as new versions ship, an attribution/credits paragraph for borrowed code, and a PayPal donation link. Thread title format is '[GUI Plugin] <Name>'.
